entities.name: Jace, Reality Sculptor
entities.description: A planeswalker and the most powerful mind-mage in the Multiverse, who builds a new reality plane by plane after learning in the Meditation Realm how to turn an illusion real.

entities.name: Jace, Multiverse Architect
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Jace who builds his reality with unrelenting persistence and uncharacteristic recklessness, certain only he can do it.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: A slice of Jace's fractured personality that took over after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm, locking away his empathy and wisdom and monitoring the final step of his plan.

entities.name: Tam, the Possibility Gorgon
entities.description: A gorgon created by Jace Beleren, his spy and agent, who is figuring out who she is and beginning to doubt his methods after meeting Strixhaven students.

entities.name: Ajani Resolute
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker motivated by his deceased brother's legacy, who mentors fellow planeswalkers and is healing from the pain he caused under phyresis; he prepares to defend the Multiverse against a former friend.

entities.name: Ajani Unrelenting
entities.description: An Echoverse leonin whose battle cry strikes fear, dedicated to vengeance after his brother's death and lashing out at anyone in the Theorist's way.

entities.name: Jazal
entities.description: Ajani's brother, a kind and just leader struck down during Alara's Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.

entities.name: Chandra, Torch of Defiance
entities.description: An impulsive, powerful pyromancer planeswalker learning to lead, who has a strange mental link to Jace and will burn his false reality down if needed.

entities.name: Chandra, Chill of Compliance
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Chandra Nalaar who is a measured, calm Avishkar consul shieldguard with cryomancy, and has embraced the Theorist's vision.

entities.name: Garruk, Curse Breaker
entities.description: A mighty hunter and solitary mage who prefers beasts to people, once cursed against his will, who joins the hunt for Jace to stop him erasing the Multiverse.

entities.name: Garruk, Veiled Butcher
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Garruk who donned the Chain Veil in the Onakke Catacombs, summons predators, and works as the Theorist's assassin.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who offered Garruk a way to suppress the beast within him with a powerful artifact in the Onakke Catacombs.

entities.name: Liliana the Repentant
entities.description: A ruthless former planeswalker haunted by those she could not save, who now tries to support the greater good; she is a necromancer-turned-professor held prisoner in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Liliana the Faultless
entities.description: An Echoverse healer from Benalia, a member of the Forward Order, who has lived hundreds of years and assists the Theorist as Professor Opal.

entities.name: Vraska, the Cutting Glare
entities.description: A gorgon and former assassin who believes Jace is dead, keeps the young Loot out of harm's way, and resolves to stop Jace when she hears he may have survived.

entities.name: Vraska, Soul of Stone
entities.description: An Echoverse gorgon raised under the guilds of Ravnica who can animate statues, remains unguilded, and is a valuable ally to the Theorist though not a replacement for his Vraska.

entities.name: Emrakul, the Exigent Doom
entities.description: The largest and most terrifying Eldrazi titan, who brings ruin for organic life and willingly allowed the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad.

entities.name: Denzilore Fatehold
entities.description: A three-faced Echoverse sphinx who founded his school to improve outlook for denizens of Arcavios, surrounded by scrolls showing the past, present and future.

entities.name: Uldaros Theorix
entities.description: A sphinx who sought students with a thirst for knowledge, used reality-bending magic to build the first fortress of Hexhaven and adorns himself with chains of equations.

entities.name: Ingris Stingerquill
entities.description: A sphinx who reads emotions and influences others with words, teaching followers to draw power from their core; her group is Hexhaven's first line of defense against mage hunters and witchstalkers.

entities.name: Aerid Konstrari
entities.description: A sphinx who animates inert materials using heartwood crystals charged from the leyline confluence under Hexhaven and has taught followers to build huge constructs.

entities.name: Kwia Vigorbloom
entities.description: A sphinx with wings of flowering plants and vines who cultivates plant matter and teaches healers to patch injuries with flora.

entities.name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
entities.description: The most restricted tome in the Hexhaven Folioplex, containing dangerous arcane knowledge, which gained sentience and is eager to escape.

entities.name: Arni, Renowned Champion
entities.description: A hero known as Goatleaper, Brokenbrow and Metalbrow, leader of the Tuskeri, who headbutted a troll and a Phyrexian.

entities.name: Arni, Humble Scribe
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Arni, a shepherd turned storyteller sailing the waves for new stories, whom few can recall by face.

entities.name: Danitha, Sword of Hope
entities.description: The heir to House Capashen and leader of her house, trained in warfare and diplomacy, who leads her forces in their war with the Cabal.

entities.name: Danitha, Spear of Agony
entities.description: An Echoverse Cabal knight, right hand of Belzenlok, who leads the demon's forces against Benalish houses.

entities.name: Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord
entities.description: A vampire, Edgar Markov, who discovered the secret to alchemical vampirism and is an ancestor of every vampire on Innistrad; he lies low in the taverns of Havengul after a failed wedding and power grab.

entities.name: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign
entities.description: An Echoverse werewolf Edgar Markov, who united the howlpacks and was once imprisoned in the Helvault by his grandson Sorin.

entities.name: Fblthp, Impossibly Lost
entities.description: A humble homunculus from Ravnica who stumbles into dangerous events and wants to go home.

entities.name: Fblthp, Knows the Way
entities.description: An Echoverse homunculus navigator created to help an Izzet shockmage who now explores the Multiverse and can always find his way back to Ravnica.

entities.name: Gallia, the Merrymaker
entities.description: A satyr known as Lord of Misrule whose roving parties never stop, even during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Gallia, Tragic Host
entities.description: An Echoverse zombie satyr, a Returned who kept partying after eating poisoned food, who sets tables for guests who never come.

entities.name: Ghalta the Unstoppable
entities.description: A titanic dinosaur tyrant released from Orazca, the manifestation of nature's consuming hunger, who defended Ixalan and fought Phyrexians when Huatli summoned her.

entities.name: Ghalta the Immovable
entities.description: An Echoverse three-horned dinosaur guardian with a cannon-proof hide who migrates farther to face the pirates threatening her kind.

entities.name: Gideon's Memorial
entities.description: A memorial on Theros to Kytheon Iora, known as Gideon Jura, a founding member of the Gatewatch who died saving Liliana Vess from Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Gideon the Oathless
entities.description: An Echoverse Kytheon Iora who learned sinister magic in prison, killed fellow inmates to defeat Heliod, and took the name Gideon Jura to avoid being remembered.

entities.name: Hapatra, the Desert Fang
entities.description: A human vizier of the snake god Rhonas who now leads the refugees of Naktamun.

entities.name: Hapatra, the Desert Frost
entities.description: An Echoverse vizier who left Kefnet to his fate and now serves the undead monarchs of the high desert.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone
entities.description: A human healer who travels with his hound Mowu and helped save Ravnica and Shenmeng; he lost his spark in the war.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu, Alone
entities.description: An Echoverse Jiang Yanggu, feared by bandits and assassins in Shenmeng, who seeks vengeance for the death of Mowu.

entities.name: Karn, Argent Defender
entities.description: A silver golem, time traveler and world forger, creator of Mirrodin, who makes amends for his role in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Karn, Gilded Guardian
entities.description: An Echoverse golden golem given an artificial spark by Mishra, who forged Mirrodin and guards it as shepherd.

entities.name: Kiora of Salt and Sand
entities.description: A merfolk who leads krakens, leviathans and serpents and stole the bident of Thassa, unable to find a route back to Zendikar.

entities.name: Kiora of Fire and Ashes
entities.description: An Echoverse merfolk from Akoum who is the mightiest dragon rider on Zendikar.

entities.name: Koth, the Geomancer
entities.description: A Vulshok geomancer from Mirrodin who fought New Phyrexia and now fathers the remaining Mirrans on Zhalfir.

entities.name: Koth of the Homestead
entities.description: An Echoverse Vulshok farmer on Mirrodin who tends steelfruit orchards with protection magic.

entities.name: Loot, the Nexus
entities.description: A mysterious creature discovered in stasis in a Fomori vault on Thunder Junction who can divine Omenpaths; he is in the care of Vraska and Ranna Beleren on Vryn.

entities.name: Loot, the Anomaly
entities.description: An Echoverse feral creature trapped in a dark vault, surrounded by miasma, which the Theorist wants to keep hidden.

entities.name: Lyra, Archangel of Dawn
entities.description: The leader of the Order of Dawn who led the Benalish defense against the Phyrexians and was knighted by Danitha Capashen.

entities.name: Lyra, Tolarian Archangel
entities.description: An Echoverse angel and headmaster of the Tolarian Academy who raised Traxos and rebuilt it as a guardian.

entities.name: Mabel, Valley Hero
entities.description: A mouse, mother of three, wielder of the sword Cragflame, who saved Valley by returning the egg of the Calamity Beast Maha.

entities.name: Mabel, Bitter Recluse
entities.description: An Echoverse mouse warlock with the staff Cragbane who drains Calamity Beasts of power to avenge her destroyed village on King Glarb.

entities.name: Marwyn, the Preserver
entities.description: An elf druid, diplomat and midwife of the Kelfae elves of Llanowar.

entities.name: Marwyn, the Clearcutter
entities.description: An Echoverse elf who is the foremost clearcutter of the Kelfae, logging the forest for the survival of her people.

entities.name: Massacre Girl, Most Wanted
entities.description: Ravnica's foremost murderer, considered an innovator even by other Rakdos.

entities.name: Rescue Girl, First Responder
entities.description: Selesnya's preeminent hero, a first responder with acrobatics and healing magic.

entities.name: Pia, Determined Rebuilder
entities.description: Pia Nalaar, a human artificer and former revolutionary, Chandra's mother, who leads Avishkar as an assembly member.

entities.name: Pia, Aether Ascetic
entities.description: An Echoverse Pia Nalaar who stands against the Consulate and tends a garden she hopes her daughter will one day enjoy.

entities.name: Proft, Consulting Detective
entities.description: Alquist Proft, a brilliant detective and former Azorius lawmage who maps Ravnica's Omenpaths.

entities.name: Proft, Sinister Mastermind
entities.description: An Echoverse Alquist Proft, said to be an unreal mastermind behind crime in Ravnica.

entities.name: Ruric Thar, Magecrusher
entities.description: An ogre of the Gruul trapped by the Simic with poisoned legs of lamb, who cannot be contained.

entities.name: Ruric Thar, Biomagus
entities.description: An Echoverse two-headed ogre crab, one of the Simic Combine's most brilliant biomages, who experiments on themselves.

entities.name: Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar
entities.description: Saheeli Rai, a master inventor who lost her spark and returned to Avishkar after staying on Ixalan with Huatli.

entities.name: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight
entities.description: An Echoverse Saheeli Rai who surveys Avishkar through a network of thopter spies.

entities.name: Samut, Hazoret's Champion
entities.description: A fast-thinking de facto leader of the living in Naktamun who works with Hapatra and seeks the favor of all the gods.

entities.name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
entities.description: An Echoverse wizard who rules Naktamun with the frozen god and can slow time to the point of freezing.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
entities.description: A hunted woman who opens magical doorways to slip refugees out of Phyrexia's clutches and is on the run again.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer
entities.description: An Echoverse bounty hunter who uses a magical net to teleport lawbreakers into stasis spheres.

entities.name: Teyo, Lightshield Expert
entities.description: Teyo Verada, sole survivor of diamond storms in Gobakhan, who learned shield magic and now protects Gobakhan with unorthodox techniques.

entities.name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
entities.description: An Echoverse Teyo Verada who became a diamondblade assassin after harnessing diamondstorms.

entities.name: Thalia, the Survivor
entities.description: The founder of the Order of Saint Traft, who works with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses across Innistrad after the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Geist of Saint Thalia
entities.description: An Echoverse spirit of Thalia, killed on Avacyn's order, who protects her cathedral for anyone seeking shelter.

entities.name: Tinybones, Pocket Nuisance
entities.description: A magical thieving skeleton who steals as an art form and keeps the spirits of Urborg safe.

entities.name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
entities.description: An Echoverse skeleton who defends the wilds of Yavimaya, especially the birds.

entities.name: Tomik, Orzhov Lawmage
entities.description: Tomik Vrona, raised by Orzhov advokists, Teysa's second in command, and husband of Ral Zarek.

entities.name: Tomik, Izzet Sparkmage
entities.description: An Echoverse Tomik Vrona, a talented Izzet sparkmage with a considerable temper, and husband of Ral.

entities.name: Traxos, Scourge Eternal
entities.description: A dragon engine known as the Scourge of Kroog, which led Mishra's legions and later deemed Phyrexian invaders enemies too.

entities.name: Traxos, Academy Guardian
entities.description: An Echoverse dragon engine raised and rebuilt by Lyra to protect Tolaria.

entities.name: Winter, Tormented Loner
entities.description: A survivor cursed to serve Valgavoth in Duskmourn, finding a glimmer of hope.

entities.name: Winter, Team Player
entities.description: An Echoverse survivor and cunning leader in Duskmourn who hunts Marina Vendrell to rescue her from herself.

entities.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
entities.description: A frog spirit with an insatiable appetite, kept in check by Muldrotha and fused with Multani during the Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: Yargle, Terror of Otaria
entities.description: An Echoverse frog spirit feared by the people of Otaria, who devastated Cabal forces in the Second Brothers' War.

entities.name: Yoshimaru, Beloved Companion
entities.description: The Emperor's faithful hound, who guarded Kamigawa's empty throne until her return.

entities.name: Yoshimaru, Scrappy Stray
entities.description: An Echoverse street dog, leader of a Towashi pack, called the Stray Emperor by some.

entities.name: Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows
entities.description: A former orphan and smuggler who strangled an Imperial guard and stalks Towashi as the Tiger's Shadow.

entities.name: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty
entities.description: An Echoverse warrior who pledged loyalty to Tamiyo and remains her devoted living shield.

entities.name: Nissa, Leyline Tamer
entities.description: An elf rebel who fights the Kor Empire by harnessing their hedron network.

entities.name: Akroma, Angel of Fury
entities.description: An angel manifested by Nivea from her grief and rage to take vengeance, who hunts those who commit injustice.

entities.name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
entities.description: An archangel created by Sorin Markov, who imprisoned her sisters in the Helvault and demands faith beyond death.

entities.name: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand
entities.description: A philanthropist with a golden hand whose mercantile guild stretches across Fiora and other planes.

entities.name: Ginger, Queen of Sweets
entities.description: A cookie queen who took up the fork the moment she was baked and leads her kingdom to victory.

entities.name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Corsair
entities.description: A sky pirate and pilot of the Weatherlight, with pseudo-immortality, who stole the Blackblade from the Cabal.

entities.name: Memnarch, the Warden
entities.description: A construct made from the remnants of the Mirari and a golden plate from Karn, warden of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
entities.description: A dragon spirit who died against the nephilim and bought a seat on the Ghost Council, becoming its sole member.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis, the Ascended
entities.description: A demonic general freed from his contract by angels in Capenna who vowed to serve them.

entities.name: Omnath, Locus of the Void
entities.description: An elemental of voracious emptiness that consumes mana and escaped a Kor Skyclave prison.

entities.name: Tamiyo, Upriser Crowned
entities.description: A moonfolk who stirred the Uprisers to attack and now rules Kamigawa reluctantly as Emperor.

entities.name: The Ur-Sphinx
entities.description: A godlike sphinx avatar whose blood and magic course through every sphinx; a powerful telepath second only to Jace.

entities.name: Venser, Fervent Forger
entities.description: A magical thief who teleports into vaults and joined Jhoira's crew.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who once trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica and sent agents after Tetsuko's family.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A titan whom Kytheon was told to defeat for freedom.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The snake god whom Hapatra served as vizier, who died.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god whom Hapatra followed before he was left to his fate.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon who locked the gods behind the gate to the afterlife and blotted out Amonkhet's sun.

entities.name: Mowu
entities.description: Jiang Yanggu's faithful hound, killed by unknown assailants in the Echoverse version.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A mercenary who stole the egg of the Calamity Beast Maha.

entities.name: Maha
entities.description: A mighty Calamity Beast whose egg was stolen.

entities.name: Glarb
entities.description: The king whom Mabel blames for the destruction of her village.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Edgar's grandson, who created the angel Avacyn and imprisoned Edgar in the Helvault.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A sinister figure imprisoned in the Helvault.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: Thalia's longtime comrade who was ordered to kill her and interred her relics.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: The Urborg elemental who called upon her father Multani to fuse with Yargle.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Muldrotha's father, who fused with Yargle to defend Urborg.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A planeswalker who gave Karn an artificial spark and whose legions Traxos led.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Karn's creator.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: A war mage who manifested Akroma after losing her lover.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker who summoned Ghalta and is Saheeli's beloved.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Tomik's husband, who left Ravnica on important business.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother, who cares for Loot with Vraska on Vryn.

entities.name: Teysa
entities.description: The Orzhov leader whose second in command was Tomik.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon who rules the rooms of Duskmourn.

entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: A woman whose control over Valgavoth Winter believes caused deaths.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon whose right hand is Danitha.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker who works with Thalia on defenses.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whose champion Samut is.

entities.name: Malach
entities.description: Koth's friend, a merchant caravan master.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: The leader of dinosaur poachers threatening Ghalta.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: Dack Fayden's planeswalking partner.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The queen of Fiora who hates Dack Fayden.

entities.name: Lord Aniseed
entities.description: The king consort Ginger marries.

entities.name: Kiran
entities.description: Pia's husband, who died at the hands of the Consulate.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: The former Rakdos guild leader being tortured by Massacre Girl.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: A mirrored version of reality created by Jace Beleren in which history looks different and legends have different fates.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The place whose magic let Jace transform illusions into reality.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The Echoverse academy first built by Uldaros Theorix, with a Folioplex, protected from mage hunters.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university where Liliana was kidnapped by her double.

entities.name: Onakke Catacombs
entities.description: A site on Shandalar where the demon Kothophed called to Garruk.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of the Conflux Wars in which Jazal died.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane ruled by the Consulate in the Echoverse and led by Pia in the normal version.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane with the moon where Emrakul was sealed.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of Kroog, Tolaria and Benalia.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane forged by Karn.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Gideon's home plane which memorializes him.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane with guilds, home to Fblthp, Proft and others.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane with Naktamun and new gods.

entities.name: Shenmeng
entities.description: The plane of Jiang Yanggu.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of Yuriko, Tamiyo and Yoshimaru.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The continent home to Ghalta and dinosaurs.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane of Kiora, Nissa and Omnath.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: The plane where Loot is cared for by Ranna Beleren.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: A plane where angels burned the contract out of Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Gobakhan
entities.description: The plane of Teyo and its diamond storms.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A kingdom destroyed by Traxos in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The home of Mabel, saved from Maha.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A faction at war with Benalia, with Danitha as a knight in the Echoverse.

entities.name: House Capashen
entities.description: The Benalish house led by Danitha.

entities.name: Order of Dawn
entities.description: The order led by Lyra.

entities.name: Forward Order
entities.description: A convocation of clerics in Benalia to which the Echoverse Liliana belonged.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: The order founded by Thalia.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that trapped Ruric Thar and employs the biomagus.

entities.name: Kor Empire
entities.description: The empire ruling Zendikar that Nissa rebels against and that imprisoned Omnath.

entities.name: Uprisers
entities.description: The rebel group Tamiyo joined and stirred to attack.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers who sealed Emrakul in the moon of Innistrad.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The agency Proft joined after leaving the Azorius.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The ruling power on Avishkar in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact of evil soul-binding magic donned by Garruk, Veiled Butcher.

events.summary: Jace resolves to create a new reality that erases the trauma and suffering of the Multiverse.
events.quote: He has resolved to create a new reality instead

events.summary: In the Meditation Realm, Jace learns to transform an illusion into something real.
events.quote: Using the magic of the Meditation Realm, Jace learned how to transform an illusion into something real.

events.summary: Jace's mind fractures after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm, and the Theorist takes over.
events.quote: Jace's mind fractured after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm.

events.summary: Jace creates Tam, who becomes his spy and agent to gather the final pieces for the new reality.
events.quote: Created by Jace Beleren, Tam has dutifully followed and learned from her teacher.

events.summary: Ajani's brother Jazal is killed during the Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.
events.quote: Ajani's brother, Jazal, was a kind and just leader struck down during Alara's Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.

events.summary: Ajani carves a trail of carnage across the Echoverse seeking revenge for his brother.
events.quote: He carved a trail of carnage across the Echoverse as he sought revenge against those he judged responsible for his brother's death.

events.summary: Jace meddles with Chandra's mind at the Ghirapur Grand Prix, leaving her a strange mental link to him.
events.quote: After Jace meddled with her mind during the Ghirapur Grand Prix, Chandra developed a strange mental link to him.

events.summary: Tempted by Kothophed, Garruk dons the Chain Veil in the Onakke Catacombs.
events.quote: Tempted by the offer, Garruk donned the Chain Veil, an artifact of evil soul-binding magic.

events.summary: Liliana is kidnapped by her double on Strixhaven and held prisoner in the Echoverse.
events.quote: is being held prisoner in the Echoverse, having been kidnapped by her doppelgänger on Strixhaven

events.summary: Hearing rumors that Jace survived, Vraska resolves that she must be the one to stop him.
events.quote: Vraska resolves that she must be the one to stop him.

events.summary: Emrakul allows the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad, waiting until the time is right.
events.quote: she willingly allowed the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad.

events.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds the first fortress of Hexhaven, raising the campus out of the reach of mage hunters.
events.quote: He used his reality-bending magic to build the first fortress of Hexhaven

events.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself against Nicol Bolas to save Liliana Vess.
events.quote: he sacrificed himself to save Liliana Vess

events.summary: Kytheon kills the other inmates with his magic to defeat Heliod and wins his freedom.
events.quote: Kytheon succeeded, but only because his magic killed the other inmates by siphoning their lifeforce to strengthen him.

events.summary: Rhonas dies and Hapatra takes leadership over the refugees of Naktamun.
events.quote: When Rhonas died, Hapatra gained new purpose

events.summary: Hapatra leaves Kefnet to his fate when he will not stand against Razaketh.
events.quote: Hapatra was a devoted follower of Kefnet, until she saw that he would not stand up against the demon Razaketh and left him to his fate.

events.summary: Mowu is killed by unknown assailants and Yanggu casts aside his peaceful ways.
events.quote: When Mowu was killed by unknown assailants, Yanggu cast aside his peaceful ways, craving only vengeance.

events.summary: Karn forges Mirrodin, a plane of peace and prosperity.
events.quote: He forged Mirrodin, a shining metal plane of peace and prosperity that would never know about the horrors of war.

events.summary: Lyra receives an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen to further ties between the Serrans and Benalia.
